create_vectors_from_list: create a Vectors object from a list of floats representing 2D or 3D coordinates
normalize_vectors: normalize a Vectors object in place so each vector has unit length
cross_product_vectors: compute the cross product of two Vectors objects with matching 2D or 3D dimensions
perpendicular_vectors: compute perpendicular vectors to a Vectors object with optional clockwise or counter clockwise direction
average_vectors: compute the average of a collection of vectors along the first axis
